name: list_metrics
description: Discover CloudWatch metrics and their dimension values in a namespace. Use this BEFORE get_metric_data to find out which dimensions and values exist. For EKS pod and node utilization use namespace 'ContainerInsights'. Returns metric names plus the distinct values found for each dimension key.

namespace.description: CloudWatch namespace (required). Examples: 'ContainerInsights' for EKS pod/node metrics, 'AWS/EC2', 'AWS/RDS', 'AWS/Lambda'.

metric_name.description: Optional filter to one metric, e.g. 'pod_cpu_request'.

dimensions.description: Optional dimension filter as a flat object, e.g. {"ClusterName": "demo-cluster"}. Only metrics matching all supplied dimensions are returned.

name: get_metric_data
description: Retrieve CloudWatch metric datapoints, with optional metric math. Returns timestamps, values and a min/max/avg/latest summary. IMPORTANT for rightsizing: Container Insights has no ready-made 'utilization over request' metric (only *_over_pod_limit exists), so compute the ratio with metric math - fetch pod_cpu_usage_total as m1 and pod_cpu_request as m2 with return_data false, then add a query {"id": "e1", "expression": "m1/m2*100"}. A result with zero datapoints usually means the resource is not instrumented, not that usage is zero.

start_time.description: Start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (required). CloudWatch retains 1-minute data for 15 days, 5-minute for 63 days, 1-hour for 455 days.

end_time.description: End of the window, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (required).

namespace.description: Simple mode: the namespace for a single metric. Ignored if 'queries' is supplied.

metric_name.description: Simple mode: the metric name. Ignored if 'queries' is supplied.

dimensions.description: Simple mode: dimensions as a flat object, e.g. {"ClusterName": "demo-cluster", "PodName": "demo-web", "Namespace": "demo-app"}.

period.description: Aggregation period in seconds (default 3600). Must be a multiple of 60.

stat.description: Statistic: Average, Sum, Minimum, Maximum, SampleCount, or an extended statistic such as p95 or p99. For rightsizing, p95 of usage is a more defensible target than Average.

queries.description: Advanced mode enabling metric math. Each item is either a raw metric {id, namespace, metric_name, dimensions, stat, period, return_data} or an expression {id, expression, label}. Ids must start with a lowercase letter. Set return_data false on raw metrics that only feed an expression.

id.description: Identifier, lowercase first letter, e.g. 'm1' or 'e1'.

metric_name.description: Metric name for a raw metric.

expression.description: Metric math expression referencing other ids, e.g. 'm1/m2*100'.

return_data.description: Whether to return this series. Defaults true for expressions, false for raw metrics.
